reservation-history-page.sql: select r.*,s.code seat_code,s.has_power,rm.name room_name,rm.code room_code from core.reservation r join core.seat s on s.id=r.seat_id join core.room rm on rm.id=r.room_id where r.user_id='9dc7ff23-c11d-5b43-78db-a7feded72094'::uuid order by r.start_at desc,r.id limit 20 offset 0

reservation-history-count.sql: select count(*) from (select r.*,s.code seat_code,s.has_power,rm.name room_name,rm.code room_code from core.reservation r join core.seat s on s.id=r.seat_id join core.room rm on rm.id=r.room_id where r.user_id='9dc7ff23-c11d-5b43-78db-a7feded72094'::uuid order by r.start_at desc,r.id) page_count

availability-page.sql:
select s.id,s.id seat_id,s.room_id,s.code,s.has_power,r.name room_name,r.code room_code,b.name building_name,c.name campus_name,r.building_id,b.campus_id,true available
      from core.room r join core.seat s on s.room_id=r.id and s.enabled
      join core.building b on b.id=r.building_id and b.enabled
      join core.campus c on c.id=b.campus_id and c.enabled
      join core.app_user u on u.id='9dc7ff23-c11d-5b43-78db-a7feded72094'::uuid
      where r.enabled and (r.department_id is null or r.department_id=u.department_id)
      and not exists(select 1 from generate_series('2026-10-24T12:00:00+08:00'::timestamptz,'2026-10-24T13:00:00+08:00'::timestamptz-interval '1 hour',interval '1 hour') requested_hour
        where not exists(select 1 from core.opening_rule opening where opening.room_id=r.id
          and opening.weekday=extract(isodow from requested_hour at time zone 'Asia/Shanghai')
          and opening.start_minute<=extract(hour from requested_hour at time zone 'Asia/Shanghai')*60
          and opening.end_minute>=(extract(hour from requested_hour at time zone 'Asia/Shanghai')+1)*60))
      and not exists(select 1 from core.resource_claim claim where claim.room_id=r.id
        and (claim.seat_id is null or claim.seat_id=s.id) and claim.released_at is null
        and claim.start_at<'2026-10-24T13:00:00+08:00'::timestamptz and (claim.end_at is null or claim.end_at>'2026-10-24T12:00:00+08:00'::timestamptz))
      and not exists(select 1 from core.reservation own where own.user_id='9dc7ff23-c11d-5b43-78db-a7feded72094'::uuid
        and own.status in('RESERVED','CHECKED_IN') and own.start_at<'2026-10-24T13:00:00+08:00'::timestamptz and own.end_at>'2026-10-24T12:00:00+08:00'::timestamptz)
      order by r.code,s.code limit 20 offset 0

Plans.Index Cond: ((user_id = '9dc7ff23-c11d-5b43-78db-a7feded72094'::uuid) AND (start_at < '2026-10-24 05:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone) AND (end_at > '2026-10-24 04:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone))

Plans.Join Filter: (((claim.seat_id IS NULL) OR (claim.seat_id = s.id)) AND (claim.room_id = r.id))
(((r.department_id IS NULL) OR (r.department_id = u.department_id)) AND (b.id = r.building_id))

Plans.Filter: ((room_id = r.id) AND ((weekday)::numeric = EXTRACT(isodow FROM (requested_hour.requested_hour AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai'::text))) AND ((start_minute)::numeric <= (EXTRACT(hour FROM (requested_hour.requested_hour AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai'::text)) * '60'::numeric)) AND ((end_minute)::numeric >= ((EXTRACT(hour FROM (requested_hour.requested_hour AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai'::text)) + '1'::numeric) * '60'::numeric)))
((end_at IS NULL) OR (end_at > '2026-10-24 04:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone))

      join core.campus c on c.id=b.campus_id and c.enabled

          and opening.start_minute<=extract(hour from requested_hour at time zone 'Asia/Shanghai')*60
          and opening.end_minute>=(extract(hour from requested_hour at time zone 'Asia/Shanghai')+1)*60))
      and not exists(select 1 from core.resource_claim claim where claim.room_id=r.id
